title: Literal or variable?

source.note: Approved local sources only; bind source IDs to local files outside Git. No external browsing.

instructions: Read the approved pages, then close the book.
From a blank values_variables.py, create five variables containing text and numeric values.
Reassign two variables and print them again.
Deliberately use one unquoted text value, run it, and preserve the error.
teaching_objectives: Distinguish a literal value from a variable name.
Explain why quotes create text and an unquoted identifier requests a name lookup.
Predict the effect of reassignment on subsequent output.
